historicalScope: This investigation describes the pre-implementation source tree named below. The replacement qualification records the implemented per-hit gain path.
scope: Investigation only; no BREAK velocity DSP or project changes made

dispatch.contract: brk callback takes step16,bar,samples_per_16th,enabled; no velocity argument
Motion applies before dispatch, BREAK settings/pin/enabled forwarded with no strike amplitude
voice_start_on owns two-voice snapshot/crossfade, g starts0 and dg=1/88; old voice fades independently. Render sums sample*g, then multiplies shared gate and global BRK_LEVEL.

facts: brkpart_t has steps/settings/slots/slice_mode/rate/slice[16], no per-step velocity field
T_VEL validator rejects l.part>=NKIT and admits only encoded drum kit/voice with i0
T_VEL mot_apply writes only seq.drum_vel[NKIT][NDRUM]; BREAK ignored
seq_out.brk and brk_voice_t have no trigger-velocity contract; g/dg are crossfade envelope, not velocity

reversibleRouteAssessment: Existing sparse motion storage could represent a future BREAK velocity lane without adding a pattern plane, but requires admitted T_VEL domain/default semantics, validator/save compatibility and engine/voice gain dispatch. It is not a FWUI-only binding. A per-trigger gain must be latched per accepted sequence voice and retained by tails/reverse/grain retriggers; live keys and preview need explicit unity/current behavior. Default unity scaling and conditional/sub-trigger semantics need owner definition. Do not repurpose LEVEL, gate, g/dg, reserved pattern fields or global mixed-output gain.

ownerHistory.record: BREAK has no admitted per-step velocity path yet. Never call LEVEL velocity.
ownerHistory.attributionLimit: This is verified baseline implementation policy, not evidence of a separate explicit user veto on adding genuine velocity. Earlier full Git history is not available from this closure. Current task explicitly reserves live/preview/tail behavior to the engine owner.

criticalSection.existing: BREAK lock_turn and prob_turn acquire plat_cq_lock before held-target/context/value read and mutations. Other families retain existing native helper discipline. plat_cq_lock masks ALNK0 on CPU0 and restores prior source-mask state; not a global IRQ lock. motion_step can mutate lane.val[] while recording.
criticalSection.foundGap: Prior visible-lane BREAK generic write was guarded, but prepare/read happened before guard; could overwrite an intervening audio recording update.
criticalSection.remedy: Separate scoped controls-break-transaction.patch now moves complete BREAK nonchance transaction under one guard. Chance retains its own guard; failed/no-op generic edits do not add dirty. Native helper-owned chance/synth note semantics retained.
